_help: The structure of the tutorial: lessons, goals, what to point at, the queries. The words
(every 'say', 'dummy', 'restate', 'off_goal', quest 'label', coach line and dummy line)
live in data/story/tutorial.script; the game puts them back here when it loads.
Edit the wording there freely; tests measure every line.
WHERE TEXT GOES (and how long it may be)
- 'say' is spoken by the Grimoire in its strip: 2 lines of 46 characters,
or 1 line when the same step also has a 'write'.
- 'write' is a query shown under 'say' in query colours: 44 characters.
- 'dummy' is the Training Dummy's speech bubble: 2 lines of 26 characters.
- 'keys' is the reminder at the bottom of the book: 76 characters.
- a quest 'label' is one checklist line: 42 characters.
- {rows} {cast} {lost} {page} {mp_before} {mp_after} {rune} are filled in by the game.
A LESSON, IN ORDER
- intro: the Grimoire talks.  Then it types 'example' itself and casts it (the demo).
- demo_after: it explains its own result.  task: the player writes the same query.
- success: what it says when the player's query met the 'goal'.
GHOST (how much of 'example' the page offers as faded text)
- full: the whole query, TAB writes it.   keywords: only SELECT and FROM.
- hint: nothing faded, a hint line instead.   none: nothing.
GOAL (a lesson passes on what the query DID, never on how it was typed)
- look: true        a free look: nothing was cast or used
- from: 'enemies'   the table the query read
- visible: [...]    columns that must be readable on the page (not cut off)
- spells_cast: 1    at least this many of Ada's spells took effect
POINT (what the Grimoire circles while it talks)
- row:0  cell:weakness:0  column:element  header  right_edge  cast_rows
- cut_row  status  mp_bar  foe_hp  tables_button  guide_button  ready_button
REVEAL (parts of the screen that stay hidden until a lesson shows them)
- ada_panel  foe_panel  status  looks  tables_button  guide_button

hints._help: A stuck player climbs one level when EITHER number is reached. Level 1 restates the goal and shows the query, level 2 fades in the next word, level 3 offers to write it together.

lessons.title: LOOK
lessons.keys: TAB writes the faded text     CTRL+ENTER casts it

lessons.title: CHOOSE
lessons.keys: TAB finishes a word     CTRL+ENTER casts it

lessons.title: READ
lessons.keys: CTRL+ENTER casts it     ESC skips the tutorial
lessons.example: SELECT element, power, mp_cost FROM spells
lessons.hint: columns: element, power, mp_cost   table: spells

lessons.title: CAST
lessons.keys: CTRL+ENTER casts it     ESC skips the tutorial

practice.title: PLAY
practice.keys: F5 READY     F4 TABLES     CTRL+ENTER casts     ESC skips

coach._help: One-line reactions (their words: the coach_* nodes of data/story/tutorial.script). The game adds the lesson's query under them, so the player always sees what to type next.

dummy._help: The dummy's own lines (the dummy_* nodes of data/story/tutorial.script). One is picked each time (never the same twice in a row).
dummy.name: Training Dummy
